{{Quote|Okay, anyone else able to slice that last one? I tried every trick and every bit of gear I've got, and if anyone can nail down what the Sith a 0.0.0 holonet node actually means, I want to know. I also want a copy of whatever gear you used, since I just bounced off everything when I started trying to get into the things that looked like 0.0.0.|mstrsclr, regarding a post on the Cularin holonet node by the user __0__ from node location 0.0.0|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
The handle '''mstrslcr''' was used as the user ID of a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some stage some close friends of mstrslcr were arrested by [[Thaereian military]] patrols and were never again able to return home.<ref name="destabilization" />

Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], purported evidence of a Thaereian military plot to destabilize the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] was shared on a Cularin holonet node forum and the user [[0/Legends|__0__]] responded claiming that the information was genuine and had been deliberately leaked by the [[Thaereian]]s. The holonet node location for the post by __0__ had been reported as 0.0.0 and mstrslcr attempted to slice this location to verify the origins of the message but was unsuccessful.<ref name="destabilization" />

At a later time, while practicing decrypting secure transmissions, the slicer decrypted a coded message submitted from the<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Almas]] to the<ref name="academic review" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which appeared to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] report recommending intervention in the operation of the [[Almas Academy|Almas Jedi academy]]. Uncertain whether the report was genuine and initially uncertain on what to do with it, two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after making the discovery mstrslcr shared the communique on a Cularin holonet node forum. The following day, [[Cularin holonet services]] ruled that material circulated by mstrslcr potentially breached security rules and the forum was suspended.<ref name="academic review" />
